caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, showing both its front and left side. The chair has a rectangular back with five vertical slats and slightly tapered legs connected by horizontal supports. The wood is colored in dark brown tones, with visible lines and shading to indicate depth and texture. The seat is cushioned, upholstered with fabric in shades of blue and teal, featuring a subtle, ornate pattern. The background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or details present. In the lower right corner, “HAROLD SMITH” is written in small capital letters.
title: Chair
